note: the contract everything shares — Khora produces it, Penelope weaves it, the surfaces fold it. An addressed, witnessed record with its standing and its falsifier beside it. The holograph already writes this shape ([S#] sources @ permanent address · bytes); Khora formalizes it.

fields.def: the [S#] surface ref — the thing's name on the dream, given at the surface, never the khora's own
the permanent address — byte span, URI, or absolute path. Material crosses seams by address, never by assertion (GL-00).
the measured size in bytes, or null when addressed-only (a pointer, not a payload)
who produced each part and how much — the economy, never asserted
the framings that contended — hard meaning is swarmed, never single-framed. One witness is not a fact (GL-IM-03).
the status of the claim, per discipline/hypothesis.mjs
after this many reviews the claim must be re-witnessed, or it decays
what would dissolve this ground — written beside it, never after
the ref of the entry that superseded this one — append-only, never rewritten

falsifyingControl: a ground record whose addr does not resolve, whose witnesses share one author, or whose falsifier is empty contradicts the contract — a claim with no way to be wrong is not ground, it is decoration
